description: The CAE network check runs only after what-if (and validate), so the approvers see a preview of a change Azure refuses or a deploy that breaks every app of the CAE.

patches.replace:
plat_arm what-if environment "$out/inputs.json" "$deployment" "$PLAT_DIR/what-if-early.json"
plat_env_snapshot "$out/inputs.json" "$PLAT_DIR/environment-snapshot.json"
if ! saf_cli environment cae-network
